question: In January 2022, the Supreme Court allowed NEET counselling for PG and UG admissions for 2021-2022 based on the existing ______________ quota for Other Backward Classes (OBC) in the all-India quota.
solution:
The correct answer is __**27%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

 
• 
 On the basis of the current** 27% quota **for** Other Backward Classes (OBC) **and** 10% reservation **for** Economically Weaker Sections (EWS)** in the All India Quota, the Supreme Court approved the start of the counselling procedure for **NEET-PG **and NEET-UG for 2021–22 admissions
